subject: Portal ownership attestation + SSO video walkthrough request
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena@cloudforge.io>
To: olga_petrov <olga@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: CloudForge Security Team <security@cloudforge.io>
Date: 2028-02-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Portal revalidation — owner attestation & brief SSO walkthrough

Hi Olga,

We're doing an annual revalidation of our external vendor profiles and noticed Redwood's Whistic/Vendr entries are due for owner attestation. To close our audit loop we need two small items from you: a) a completed owner attestation (I attached a template) signed by the profile owner, and b) a short (5-8 minute) screen-share video or live walkthrough showing the SSO setup (IdP metadata, service provider config, where certificates are stored). Screenshots are fine if you prefer to record.

Can you confirm who will be the attesting owner and whether your team can do a quick walkthrough next week? Requested target to publish the attestation is 2028-02-21 to keep our compliance window intact.

Attachment: owner_attestation_template.docx (template)

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morris
Security & Trust Ops — CloudForge
elena@cloudforge.io

From: olga_petrov <olga@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@cloudforge.io>
Cc: mina_haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-02-14T09:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Portal revalidation — owner attestation & brief SSO walkthrough

Thanks for the heads up, Elena — we can take this.

Quick plan:
- Ben Carter will be the attesting owner and will sign the attestation.
- Mina Haddad (Security) will be the evidence steward and collect screenshots/short recording.
- I will coordinate scheduling and confirm the published profile once everything is uploaded.

Proposed slot for a live walkthrough: Tue 2028-02-16 10:30 AM PT (30 minutes). If that doesn't work for you, please suggest alternatives.

Ben / Mina — please confirm you can own the deliverables and let me know if you need a demo account or ephemeral credentials to capture screenshots.

Olga
Olga Petrov
Head of Platform Compliance — Redwood Inference
olga@redwoodinference.com

From: mina_haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-02-14T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Portal revalidation — owner attestation & brief SSO walkthrough

Sounds good. I'll spin up a temporary demo IdP account in our staging tenant and capture the key screens (IdP metadata, SP entity ID, certificate thumbprint, SAML assertion debug). A couple of asks:
- Ben, can you draft the attestation with your contact info filled in (I can drop it back to you for signature)?
- Olga, I'll need a short-lived service account or a guest credential for CloudForge to test SSO if they want us to walk through live; otherwise I'll record the screens.

I expect to have screenshots + a short recording uploaded to a secure folder by EOD Mon 2028-02-15.

Mina
Security Engineer — Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morris <elena@cloudforge.io>
To: olga_petrov <olga@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: CloudForge Security Team <security@cloudforge.io>
Date: 2028-02-15T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Portal revalidation — owner attestation & brief SSO walkthrough

Thanks — that timeline works.

I've scheduled a 20-minute walkthrough for Tue 2028-02-16 10:30 AM PT and created a Zoom invite (link below). If you prefer to upload a pre-recorded 5–8 minute video plus screenshots, that's fine — just drop the files in the shared folder and we'll accept that in lieu of live.

Meeting: Tue 2028-02-16 10:30 AM PT
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=abc

I've also uploaded an initial set of reference screenshots we took of our vendor portal to help with mapping fields: sso_config_screenshots.zip (attached).

Attachment: sso_config_screenshots.zip (zip)

Elena

From: ben_carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga@redwoodinference.com>, mina_haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Morris <elena@cloudforge.io>
Date: 2028-02-15T14:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Portal revalidation — owner attestation & brief SSO walkthrough

Thanks everyone — I will be the profile owner and will sign the attestation. Mina, appreciate you collecting the screenshots; if you can drop the draft attestation into the same secure folder I'll review and sign.

Elena — could you send the DocuSign or DocSend link for the attestation when available? Otherwise I'll attach the signed PDF to the channel here once complete.

Plan:
- Mon EOD: Mina uploads screenshots + draft attestation to shared secure link.
- Tue 10:30: Live walkthrough (or we will upload a 6-min recording before the meeting).
- Wed morning: I will finalize and sign; Elena publishes updated profile.

Ben Carter
Senior Product Manager — Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com
